findings.description: Returns the original list reference rather than a separate copy. Modifying the returned list will mutate the input record's labels list.
findings.evidence: Calling candidate.labels({'labels': ['a']}) returns the same object as the input. Appending to the result, e.g., result.append('b'), causes record['labels'] to become ['a', 'b'], violating the contract.

review.summary: The candidate returns a reference to the original list instead of a copy, violating the requirement that caller modifications to the returned list must not change the input record.
